basic_details.job_title: HAL Non Engineering Graduate Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), Avionics Division, Korwa, Amethi invites BSc (Nursing) pass candidates for one-year apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act 1961, with the stipend paid as per rule or as revised by BOAT, Kanpur. Applications are taken only through the Google Application Form from 17 November 2026 to 1 December 2026, after registration on www.nats.education.gov.in.

how_to_apply: Register on the portal www.nats.education.gov.in to get the Registration Number.
Open the Google Application Form given in the notice (link under Important Links).
Fill the form carefully and write the Registration Number in it. Incomplete or wrongly filled forms are liable to be rejected.

Dependents (children and spouse only) of serving, retired or deceased HAL employees attach the employee's details in the Google Application Form, certified by the concerned HR Officer of the respective division in the attached format.
Submit the Google Application Form by 01/12/2026. Forms sent in any other mode, and forms submitted after 01/12/2026, are not accepted.

content_sections.heading: HAL Bachelor of Science (Nursing) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee.

rows.details: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited, Avionics Division, Korwa, Amethi
Stipend as per rule per month or as revised by BOAT, Kanpur
Maximum 26 years as on 01/12/2026 for General candidates (relaxation for OBC, SC/ST and PwD)

content_sections.heading: About HAL Avionics Division, Korwa
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by Hindustan Aeronautics Limited, Avionics Division, Korwa, Amethi-227412 (U.P.), through its Gurukulam Technical Training Institute, Korwa. The printed phone number is 05368-255887. The training is under the Apprentices Act 1961.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Age: the maximum age limit is 26 years as on 01/12/2026 for General candidates. It is relaxable by 3 years for OBC and 5 years for SC/ST candidates. For Differently Abled candidates (minimum disability 40%) the upper age limit is relaxable up to 10 years (15 years for SC/ST and 13 years for OBC). Candidates in the following situations are not eligible: Those who have completed, resigned, been terminated from, are undergoing, or are registered for apprentice training under the Apprentices Act in any organization. Those completing 5 years since passing the degree/diploma examination on 15 February 2027. Those with work experience of one year or more in any organization. Those who did a technical/general stream degree/diploma through correspondence. The notice asks applicants to register on www.nats.education.gov.in and to enter the Registration Number in the application form. The notice does not mention the minimum marks. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

rows.essential_qualification: 4 Years Degree from any Recognized Board/University in concerned Branches

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Apprentices are paid a stipend per month as per rule, or as revised by BOAT, Kanpur. No amount is printed in the notice. The apprenticeship training period is one year only. The selected candidate executes a contract for the training period as per the Apprentices Act. After training the contracts are closed, and HAL has no obligation to offer any employment.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HAL Bachelor of Science (Nursing)
content_sections.text: Register on the portal www.nats.education.gov.in to get the Registration Number. Open the Google Application Form given in the notice (link under Important Links). Fill the form carefully and write the Registration Number in it. Incomplete or wrongly filled forms are liable to be rejected. Dependents (children and spouse only) of serving, retired or deceased HAL employees attach the employee's details in the Google Application Form, certified by the concerned HR Officer of the respective division in the attached format. Submit the Google Application Form by 01/12/2026. Forms sent in any other mode, and forms submitted after 01/12/2026, are not accepted.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Apprentices are selected on a 100% merit basis, on the total aggregate marks secured in the graduation examination. Reservation is applied as per the Apprentices Act 1961. The list of provisionally selected candidates is displayed on HAL Korwa LAN/WAN/Notice Boards and in the Careers Section of www.hal-india.co.in . Provisionally selected candidates undergo a medical examination and produce a medical fitness certificate from a Government Medical Officer not below the rank of Assistant Surgeon (Gazetted). The certificate is submitted at the time of joining. Original documents are verified at HAL Korwa on the dates below.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: HAL reserves the right to change the dates, and any change will be uploaded on the HAL website.

rows.event: Receipt of applications through Google Application Form
Verification of original documents at HAL Korwa

content_sections.heading: Documents Named in the Notice
content_sections.text: Provisionally selected candidates submit self-attested copies of these documents, with one latest passport size photograph, during verification of original documents: High School Certificate and Mark sheet Mark sheets of all semesters and certificate of the Non-Engineering degree Latest caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC, as applicable PWD certificate, if applicable EWS certificate, if applicable HR certified proforma for dependents (children and spouse) of an HAL employee, if applicable Aadhar Card E-mail copy of the Apprentice Registration Number

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for HAL Korwa BSc Nursing apprentice?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the Google Application Form is 01/12/2026. Forms submitted after that date are not accepted.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for the HAL Korwa apprentice post?
faq.answer: A 4 Years Degree from any Recognized Board/University in concerned Branches, in Bachelor of Science (Nursing).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 26 years as on 01/12/2026 for General candidates. Relaxation is 3 years for OBC and 5 years for SC/ST, and 10 years for PwD (15 for SC/ST, 13 for OBC).

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Register on www.nats.education.gov.in to get a Registration Number, then fill the Google Application Form and enter that number. Applications sent in any other mode are not accepted.

faq.question: Q5. How are apprentices selected?
faq.answer: Selection is 100% merit based on total aggregate marks in the graduation examination. Reservation is applied as per the Apprentices Act 1961.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend?
faq.answer: The stipend is paid per month as per rule, or as revised by BOAT, Kanpur. The notice does not print an amount.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the training, and is it a permanent job?
faq.answer: The apprenticeship training lasts one year only. After it, the contract is closed and HAL has no obligation to offer any employment.

faq.question: Q8. When will the provisional list and document verification take place?
faq.answer: The provisionally selected candidates are to be declared on 11/12/2026-12/12/2026. Verification of original documents at HAL Korwa is on 14/12/2026 to 18/12/2026.

faq.question: Q9. Who is not eligible for this apprenticeship?
faq.answer: Candidates who already did, are doing or are registered for apprentice training under the Apprentices Act, and those with one year or more of work experience, are not eligible. Those who did a correspondence degree/diploma are also not eligible.

faq.question: Q10. Will HAL pay travel allowance for document verification?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA is paid to applicants called for verification, and they arrange their own stay if required.
